verdict: CELL-TYPE COHERENCE -- the mRNA->function->identity loop CLOSES (measured). Using per-cell-type expressed genes (emask, 200 atlas types) and the GO-Biological-Process functions of those genes: (Q1) marker cell types recover the RIGHT, cell-SPECIFIC biology -- hepatocyte -> xenobiotic/fatty-acid/steroid metabolism + coagulation; CD4 T cell -> T-cell-receptor signaling + adaptive immune response; neuron -> synaptic transmission + axon guidance; monocyte -> antigen processing + MHC assembly; cardiac muscle -> sarcomere organization + force of heart contraction (erythroid progenitor -> DNA-replication/proliferation, correct for a progenitor). (Q2) DECISIVE: cell identity is RECONSTRUCTABLE from function ALONE -- each cell type nearest-neighbour by expressed-gene-function profile shares its lineage 78% vs 11% chance (lift 7.08x). So reversing it -- taking a cell type, its expressed genes, and asking what those genes DO -- regenerates the cell functional identity: the mRNA layer and the gene-function layer are mutually CONSISTENT. HONEST LIMITS on the other two pairings requested: (Q3) PROTEIN -- we have only a GENERIC proteome (one ppm per gene, not per cell type); active genes are 2.88x more abundant than background, but a true per-cell-type mRNA<->protein comparison is NOT possible without cell-type proteomes (real data gap; HPA/Tabula proteomes would fill it). (Q4) 3D CHROMATIN -- only K562 Hi-C exists, and missing_wire_3d already showed TAD co-localisation is a weak wire (0.016); per-cell-type 3D for the 200 atlas types is not in our data. BOTTOM LINE: where the model IS cell-type-resolved (mRNA + gene-function) it is internally COHERENT and reconstructs cell identity (lift ~7x); it is NOT cell-type-resolved for PROTEIN or 3D chromatin -- those are the honest missing modalities to acquire.
